name: X-linked Scapuloperoneal Muscular Dystrophy

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and genetic diagnostic criteria for X-linked scapuloperoneal muscular dystrophy

criteria.description: Progressive weakness and atrophy of scapular stabilizing muscles
Distal lower limb weakness predominantly affecting peroneal muscles
X-linked inheritance pattern with affected male relatives
Muscle biopsy showing dystrophic changes with variable fibrosis and fatty infiltration
Identification of pathogenic variants in the gene associated with X-linked scapuloperoneal muscular dystrophy

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of progressive scapular and peroneal muscle weakness with supportive family history and confirmation by genetic testing
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Muscle biopsy and electromyography can support diagnosis but are not definitive without genetic confirmation.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Scapular winging due to scapular stabilizer muscle weakness
searchTerms: shoulder blade sticks out due to weak muscles
winged shoulder blade caused by weak stabilizers

pathognomonic.symptomName: Distal lower limb muscle atrophy predominantly affecting peroneal muscles
X-linked inheritance pattern with affected males in family
pathognomonic.notes: Family history is a key diagnostic clue

searchTerms: gradual weakness of upper arm muscles
weakness in shoulder and upper arm muscles

common.symptomName: Foot drop due to peroneal nerve involvement
searchTerms: foot drop caused by nerve damage
difficulty lifting foot due to nerve problem
mild weakness around shoulder and upper arm

common.symptomName: Mild joint contractures in affected limbs
searchTerms: mild joint stiffness and limited movement
reduced joint flexibility in affected limbs
slight breathing difficulty from muscle weakness

occasional.symptomName: Mild scoliosis secondary to muscle weakness
searchTerms: mild spine curvature from muscle weakness
early scoliosis due to weak muscles

rare.symptomName: Dysphagia due to oropharyngeal muscle weakness
searchTerms: difficulty swallowing from throat muscle weakness
trouble swallowing due to muscle problems

laboratory: Elevated serum creatine kinase (mild to moderate elevation)
imaging: Muscle MRI showing selective fatty infiltration of scapular and peroneal muscles
genetic: Pathogenic variants in the gene associated with X-linked scapuloperoneal muscular dystrophy (specific gene currently under investigation)
other: Muscle biopsy with dystrophic features and fibrosis

distinguishingFeatures: Different pattern of muscle involvement on imaging
Predominantly proximal limb weakness without distal peroneal involvement
